name: tpds-figure-6-forced-order
description: Three replicas concurrently insert A, B and C into an empty document. One of them then receives C but not B and inserts X between A and C, before finally receiving B.

expected.rationale: TPDS Fig. 6 and the paragraph preceding Def. 4: with A < B < C the only order satisfying maximal non-interleaving is AXBC. A, B and C share a left origin (start) and a right origin (end), so Def. 4 condition (3) orders them by ascending ElementId; replica ids are assigned ascending to make the paper's WLOG hold. X and C are not consecutive despite X being the only element with right origin C - the permitted exception in condition (2).
